datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Niger on a monthly basis throughout 2017. The classifications represent spatial assessments of acute food insecurity phases, which are indirect impacts of underlying hazards such as drought. Data were compiled into geographic datasets for February, June, and October 2017.
